name: Single-source-of-truth reconcile: authority by measurability, then pointer rewrite
description: Find every place a fact is stated, decide which statement is authoritative, and rewrite the others as POINTERS instead of restatements. The rule that makes it more than a search-and-replace is how authority is chosen: the authoritative source is the one that can be MEASURED, not the one that is most convenient - and when no statement is measurable the fact is marked UNVERIFIED everywhere rather than one being blessed arbitrarily. A contradiction is never resolved silently: the superseded statement and its correction go into a register, which is what stops a corrected fact from being re-learned wrong. A legitimately repeated context sentence must NOT be flagged, so the pass carries its own false-positive control.

fact_or_topic.description: The fact being reconciled, stated as the question it answers - e.g. 'how many coverage thresholds does the gate enforce'.

doc_roots.description: Documentation roots to search. One fan-out shard per root; a missed root is a silent contradiction left live.

search_terms.description: The literal terms and paraphrases to search for. Semantic search misses paraphrases, so the term list is explicit and auditable.

measurability_probe.description: The command or check that would MEASURE the fact. Authority is assigned to the statement this probe agrees with.

allow_unverified_everywhere.description: When no statement is measurable, mark the fact UNVERIFIED in every location rather than blessing one arbitrarily.

statement-finder.description: Mechanically finds every statement of the fact. Deterministic search, no judgement.

authority-adjudicator.description: Runs the measurability probe and assigns authority to the statement it agrees with. Holds the veto over an unmeasurable blessing.

false-positive-auditor.description: Distinguishes a real contradiction from a sentence that legitimately repeats context for readability.

rewriter.description: Rewrites each non-authoritative statement as a pointer to the authoritative one.

routes.reason: the finder that flagged a sentence is the least able to see that the repetition was deliberate

stages.title: S0 - find EVERY statement of the fact, mechanically

work_unit.title: Find every statement of the fact in one documentation root
work_unit.question_or_target: Search one root for every declared term and paraphrase, recording each hit with its file:line and the VALUE it asserts, so the comparison step operates on values rather than on prose.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: extracting the asserted VALUE from a sentence is judgement; finding the sentence is not

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every hit with file:line, the verbatim sentence, and the extracted value - plus the exact search terms used, so a missed paraphrase is diagnosable
tests_required: all statements of a fact stated with three different values are found, not just the first two
the search terms are recorded, so a paraphrase the term list could not match is a known gap rather than an invisible one
both-states control: a root with no statement of the fact yields zero hits and says so, rather than the shard being reported as unsearched
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the false-positive-auditor, which reads the verbatim sentences
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8401 emitted only when every hit carries file:line, the sentence and an extracted value or an explicit no-value marker; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8401 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then widen the term list once and record the widening
work_unit.mechanism: deterministic multi-term search with per-hit value extraction and a recorded term list

stages.title: Every root must be searched - a missed root leaves a contradiction live
S1 - compare the asserted values and enumerate the contradictions

work_unit.title: Group the statements by asserted value and enumerate the disagreements
work_unit.question_or_target: Partition the found statements by the value they assert and list every distinct value with its locations, so the size of the disagreement is a count rather than an impression.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: grouping by value is mechanical, so it is written as an exact partition rather than an LLM judgement over the whole set

work_unit.evidence_requirement: a value-to-locations map covering every found statement, with the count of distinct values stated explicitly
tests_required: a fact stated with three different values yields three groups, and every found statement lands in exactly one
a statement with no extractable value is grouped as NO-VALUE rather than silently dropped
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the authority-adjudicator, which needs the value groups to compare against the probe
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8402 emitted only when every found statement is assigned to exactly one value group and the distinct-value count is recorded; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8402 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then emit the ungrouped statement list rather than forcing a partition
work_unit.mechanism: exact value partition over found statements with a distinct-value count

stages.title: A sentence that legitimately repeats context is NOT a contradiction

work_unit.title: Separate real contradictions from deliberate context repetition
work_unit.question_or_target: For each flagged statement decide whether it CONTRADICTS the others or merely repeats agreed context for readability, because flagging a legitimate repeat turns a reconcile into vandalism.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the finder that flagged the sentence cannot see that the repetition was deliberate; a different vendor can

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per statement, a CONTRADICTS or LEGITIMATE-REPEAT verdict with the surrounding context that justifies it
tests_required: a legitimately-repeated context sentence with the SAME value is classified LEGITIMATE-REPEAT and is not rewritten
a statement with a DIFFERENT value is classified CONTRADICTS even when its surrounding prose reads like context
both-states control: a real three-way disagreement yields three CONTRADICTS verdicts, so the auditor is not absolving everything
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the statement-finder, which may contest a LEGITIMATE-REPEAT verdict by citing the differing value
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8403 emitted only when every statement carries one of the two verdicts with its justifying context; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8403 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then classify as LEGITIMATE-REPEAT, since a missed reconcile is recoverable and a wrong rewrite is not
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the value comparison partitions by VALUE mechanically; this decides whether a same-or-similar sentence was MEANT to restate, which no partition can answer

stages.title: The pass carries its own false-positive control
S2 - authority goes to the MEASURABLE statement, not the convenient one

work_unit.title: Run the measurability probe and assign authority to the statement it agrees with
work_unit.question_or_target: Execute the declared measurability probe, compare its result against each value group, and designate the agreeing statement authoritative - or, when the probe agrees with none, mark the fact UNVERIFIED everywhere rather than blessing a statement arbitrarily.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the judge authority is where the anti-convenience rule is enforced and cannot be delegated to the finder

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the probe command, its verbatim output, and which value group it agrees with - or an explicit statement that it agrees with none
tests_required: the designated authority is the statement the probe AGREES with, even when another location is more prominent or more convenient to cite
when the probe agrees with no statement, the fact is marked UNVERIFIED in every location and no statement is designated authoritative
the probe's own output is recorded verbatim, so a later reader can re-run it rather than trusting this designation
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the false-positive-auditor, cross-examining whether the probe actually measures the fact in question
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8404 emitted only when one value group is designated authoritative with the probe output recorded, or the fact is marked UNVERIFIED everywhere; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8404 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then mark UNVERIFIED everywhere rather than designating on a third attempt at the same probe
work_unit.mechanism: probe-driven authority designation with UNVERIFIED-everywhere as the honest fallback

stages.title: No measurable source means UNVERIFIED everywhere, not an arbitrary blessing
S3 - rewrite every non-authoritative statement as a POINTER

body.title: Rewrite one batch of restatements into pointers

work_unit.title: Replace a batch of restatements with pointers to the authoritative source
work_unit.question_or_target: Rewrite each CONTRADICTS statement as a pointer to the authoritative location, leaving LEGITIMATE-REPEAT sentences untouched, and record every edit so the pass is reversible.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: writing a pointer that still reads well in its surrounding prose is authoring work, not substitution

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per edit: the file:line, the removed value, the pointer written, and the before-text so the rewrite is reversible
tests_required: a LEGITIMATE-REPEAT sentence is left byte-identical
each rewritten location points at the authoritative file:line and no longer asserts its own value
the before-text is recorded for every edit, so the whole pass can be reverted
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the authority-adjudicator, which re-reads a sample of rewrites against the designation
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8405 emitted only when every CONTRADICTS statement is either rewritten as a pointer or listed as unrewritable with a reason; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8405 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then leave the statement in place and list it as an unresolved restatement
work_unit.mechanism: reversible pointer rewrite that spares legitimate repeats

stages.title: S4 - a contradiction is never resolved silently

work_unit.title: Write the superseded-guidance register: what each location used to claim, and the correction
work_unit.question_or_target: Record every superseded statement with its old value, its new pointer and the correction, so a corrected fact cannot be re-learned wrong from a cached copy or an old branch.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the register is the durable half of the reconcile and belongs to the role that assigned authority

work_unit.evidence_requirement: one register entry per superseded statement carrying its old value verbatim, the authoritative value, and the probe that settled it
tests_required: every rewritten location has a register entry; a rewrite with no entry is a silent resolution and fails the gate
the old value is recorded verbatim, so someone who remembers the old number can find out why it changed
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who samples entries and re-runs the probe
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8406 emitted only when the register covers every rewritten location with old value, new value and the settling probe; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8406 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then fail: an unregistered supersession defeats the purpose of the pass
work_unit.mechanism: superseded-guidance register carrying the old value and the settling probe

stages.title: Silent resolution is how a corrected fact gets re-learned wrong
S4b - add a drift check so the NEXT divergence is detected, not discovered

work_unit.title: Emit a drift check that fails when the fact is re-stated away from the authoritative source
work_unit.question_or_target: Specify a check that re-runs the measurability probe and the search, and fails when any location asserts a value again instead of pointing - so the next divergence is caught rather than rediscovered months later.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: designing a check that fails closed on an empty search walk is the difference between a gate and a no-op

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the check's input enumeration, its fail-closed rule on an empty walk, its terminal marker, and a named known-bad state that makes it exit non-zero
tests_required: the spec names a known-bad state (a location re-asserting a value) that makes the check FAIL - a check that has never gone red is indistinguishable from a no-op
an empty search walk fails CLOSED rather than reporting nothing-found as a pass
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the false-positive-auditor, checking the drift check would not fire on a legitimate repeat
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8407 emitted only when the spec carries a fail-closed rule, a terminal marker and a named known-bad state; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8407 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then emit the check as advisory-only and say so, rather than shipping an unfalsifiable gate
work_unit.mechanism: fail-closed drift-check specification with a named known-bad state

stages.title: The shared completion predicate over the reconcile

impact.blast_radius: edits documentation under docs/** and command-center/**; every edit records its before-text so the whole pass is revertible, and the schema tree is in forbid_write_paths

worked_example.scenario: This program's own coverage count: one doc says the gate enforces 5 thresholds, two others say 6, and a fourth sentence repeats 'the gate enforces the project thresholds' as context without a number.

params.fact_or_topic: how many coverage thresholds does the gate enforce

expected_trace: search-statements -> 3 roots searched in parallel; 7 hits; barrier mode all, on_partial fail (a missed root would leave a contradiction live)
compare-values -> 3 groups: value 5 (1 location), value 6 (2 locations), NO-VALUE (4 locations)
audit-false-positives -> the 4 NO-VALUE sentences are LEGITIMATE-REPEAT; the 5-versus-6 pair is CONTRADICTS
designate-authority -> the probe prints 6; the value-6 group is authoritative. Note the value-5 location was the most prominent doc, and was NOT chosen
rewrite-as-pointers -> pass 1 rewrites the value-5 location as a pointer; unresolved_restatements 1 -> 0; the 4 legitimate repeats are byte-identical
register-superseded -> 1 entry: old value 5, authoritative 6, settled by the recorded probe output
superseded-gate PASS; drift-check -> a spec that fails when any location asserts a bare number again, fail-closed on an empty walk

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED as a reusable pass - semantic search misses paraphrases, so the recorded search-term list is the honest bound on coverage rather than a claim of completeness. Settling experiment = reconcile one known-contradictory fact end to end and confirm every restatement now points at the measured source, then re-run the drift check against a deliberately re-asserted value and require it to fire.

distinct_from.BP-MNT-01: that reconciles CODE between the live tree and the repo; this reconciles a FACT across documents and ends in a pointer rewrite
distinct_from.bp-doc-02: that clusters many caveats into a new principle and can end in a SCRIPT; this takes ONE fact and adjudicates which of its statements is authoritative
distinct_from.bp-doc-01: that creates new knowledge from new work; this removes duplicate statements of knowledge that already exists
